contradictions.summary: Witness 2 says the signal was red for car A; CCTV shows green from -4.0 s to impact.
contradictions.explanation: Suggestion: Witness 2 stood on the opposite side and may have seen the cross-street signal.

contradictions.summary: Witness 1 estimates ~30 km/h; telematics records 62 km/h before braking.
contradictions.explanation: Suggestion: speed estimates by eye are commonly off by 30-50%.

contradictions.summary: Witness 3 says the pedestrian appeared suddenly; CCTV shows her on the zebra 1.6 s before impact, as Witness 1 says.
Witness 2 says car B stopped; CCTV shows car B leaving north within 0.6 s without stopping.

gaps.note: Pedestrian partly occluded by bus; only one camera covers her approach.

hypotheses.text: Car A was speeding and braked late after the pedestrian was visible
Car A ran a red signal
Pedestrian stepped out suddenly with no time to react

counterfactual.note: Distance from car A to zebra when pedestrian became visible (-1.6 s).
